description: Permissions for the main window: window basics and the app's own file commands (all limited to the open vault in Rust). The only network use is the update check, which the Settings button starts. The stopgap Update VaultOps button starts the maintainer's install script (which pulls and builds) and can start nothing else; its status check runs git fetch for main and develop in the code folder. vcs_detect only looks for an installed git vcs_status reads the vault's own history vcs_enable starts one in the vault folder and vcs_save_point records a save point there (no network).
